sources.title: Qwen Code — Free Open-Source AI Coding Agent (CLI + IDE)
sources.snippet: Qwen Code: Open-Source AI Coding Agent Qwen Code is Alibaba's open-source AI coding agent that lives in your terminal — think Claude Code or Cursor, but free and powered by Qwen3-Coder models. Install it with a single command, authenticate via Qwen OAuth for 1,000 free requests per day (no token limit), and get an AI pair-programmer that can read your codebase, write and edit files, run ...
